hypothesis: On the nine sealed 2025/26 Nasdaq ITCH sessions, over the fixed 2019-01-30 bars universe minus AAPL, MSFT and QQQ, the registered family's decile book earns a positive mean return per rebalance net of the quoted spread, judged across sessions. A fail is a negative result for that family on these sessions only above the detectable Sharpe floor (see power).

holdout.source: session keys of research/holdout_registry.json whose '*' scope is unread; raw-file names, sizes and sha256 copied from research/r7/r7_confirm_prereg.json (holdout_files) and research/data_manifest.json, recorded when the three-name datasets were ingested. No file was read for this draft.
holdout.registry_scope: per session: the '*' rule is unread; AAPL, MSFT, QQQ are spent (R7) and excluded
holdout.never: no statistic on these sessions for any name outside AAPL / MSFT / QQQ before the one signed run

universe.sha256_form: sha256 of the LF-normalised file text (iap.research.breadth_holdout.file_sha256)
universe.rule: breadth_bars_universe/v1, fixed on 2019-01-30 by liquidity facts only (500 names)
universe.missing_names: a name absent on a session is counted, never replaced (breadth_bars.rows_for)

family.name: <FILL: the one family the choice rule selects (vwap_deviation, residual_reversion, or a breadth_families name)>
family.choice_record: <FILL: path and sha256 of the in-sample record that applied the choice rule>
family.implementation: iap.research.breadth_bars.run_study for the two round-1 scores; iap.research.breadth_families.run_family otherwise (tools/breadth_bars_holdout.py default_study)

costs.per_rebalance: net = gross - (mean_long c + mean_short c) / 2 on unit gross; c = hs[entry] + hs[exit]; hs = quoted half spread over mid of the end-of-bar Nasdaq quote
costs.in_sample_reference: median round-trip spread cost 4.29 bps on 2019-01-30 (research/round1/BREADTH_BARS_20190130.md)
costs.not_modelled: fees, market impact, halts, short-sale constraints; one venue's quote overstates the consolidated spread (conservative)

statistic.definition: per session: mean net bps per rebalance of the registered family's decile book; across sessions: mean, standard error and one-sided Student t on n - 1 df (breadth_bars.pool_sessions). Sessions are the independent unit.
statistic.secondary_descriptive: gross bps, rank IC, names used, positive sessions; descriptive only

decision.rule: pass: all min_sessions sessions give a finite value, the mean is above zero and the one-sided p <= alpha_one_sided (t >= 2.306 on 8 df). incomplete: fewer sessions give a value (the look is still spent). fail: otherwise. Computed by iap.research.breadth_holdout.verdict.
decision.status: PROPOSED; the coordinator confirms before signing
decision.reasoning: 0.025 one-sided is the repository's standard level (docs/research/PNL_POWER_TABLE.md); one family is registered, so K = 1 and nothing is split; requiring all nine sessions stops download failures from choosing the sample

multiplicity.statement: One family, one parameter set, one statistic, one look. The family is chosen in-sample from several candidates by the pre-written rule; that selection is disclosed and the number of families screened is in the choice record. No second family may be run on these sessions after this look.

power.source: docs/research/PNL_POWER_TABLE.md; research/round0/ROUND0_GATES.md section 8; iap.research.pnl_power.mde_sharpe(9) = 16.94 at K = 1
power.can_show: with 80 % power, a true annualised net Sharpe of about 17 or more (K = 1, one-sided 0.025)
power.cannot_show: anything about a realistic Sharpe (1 to 5): a fail or incomplete is not evidence against such a strategy; a pass would be a very large effect, to be checked for cost-model or data artefacts before belief
power.stop_rule: ROUND0_GATES section 2 registers a confirmatory study only if its sealed session count reaches the table entry for the Sharpe it looks for; this registration states that it looks for a net Sharpe of 17 or more
